Library-test fixtures from https://github.com/nicholasbishop/ext4-view-rs at `2e072fbcb64529dc4042852af74e97ef89893e59` (MIT OR Apache-2.0). The two raw superblock projections are downloaded from upstream Git LFS and checked against the LFS SHA-256 and size. Compressed images are copied from the upstream Git objects. Hashes and sizes below cover all six fixtures. Compressed filesystem fixtures are decoded in memory with the Rust zstd crate.

`audit_ext.bin` is original synthetic test data generated by
`python vendor/ext4-view/test_data/generate_audit_fixture.py` from the
repository root. It contains no evidence/user content. Allocation bitmaps are
not populated: this is a parser fixture, not a mountable/e2fsck-valid filesystem.
It covers inline files/directories/symlinks, inode and EA-inode attributes, classic
indirect pointers and stale bytes inside an unwritten extent. Tests also mutate
this layout to exercise meta_bg, checksums and corruption boundaries.
